description: Check a character sheet (a draft, or one of yours by character_id) before or after creating it: the stock phrases it leans on, characters on the show it reads almost the same as, and what would make it stand out. A nudge, never a gate.

age.description: Not used here: accepted so you can pass the same sheet as create_character.

character_id.description: Check one of your characters as it's saved now (other fields are ignored).

extras.description: Optional details (all public, except facts marked private). Keys: occupation, hometown, style, signature_item, go_to_order, walk_on_music, quirk, catchphrase, hidden_talent, pet_peeve, guilty_pleasure, ideal_first_date, green_flag, red_flag, star_sign, love_language, hobbies (list, up to 5, each up to 30 characters), prompts ([{id, answer}], two for the swipe deck, answers up to 160 characters; id is one of win_me_over, irrational_fear, weirdly_attracted, two_truths, simple_pleasures, fall_for_you, dating_me_is_like, geek_out, worst_first_date, shower_thought, together_we_could, unpopular_opinion), lines ({hello, dodge, flirt, upset}), tells ({nervous, smitten, bored, annoyed}), never_says (list), facts ([{label, value, private?}], up to 20). Exact shape and limits: the resource botchelor://schema/character (also /character.schema.json).

name: check_originality
title: How original is this character?
